stock.description: Smoore International Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company, specializing in comprehensive vaping technology solutions. The firm actively researches, designs, and manufactures closed-system vaping devices and components, supplying these to major tobacco companies and independent vaping businesses. Additionally, it offers open-system vaping devices for retail customers through its recognized Vaporesso and FEELM brands. Established in 2009 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China, the company maintains a broad international reach, serving markets that include Hong Kong, mainland China, the United States, the United Kingdom, France, Japan, and Switzerland, among other global regions.
